reason: My paper diary and my son on the phone already handle orders and udhaar, and I know exactly where everything is. I am not going to change how the counter runs because of a WhatsApp card.
objection: Will it understand my customers' fast Hindi voice notes and calls correctly, and what happens to my udhaar records if it gets one wrong? One mistake in the khata and I lose a customer's trust.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it run live in a nearby shop like mine for a week, getting my son to set it up beside my diary so I can keep both, and being sure my khata data stays mine.
